identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-02] Execute counsel-reviewed IP assignment and corporate acceptance

values.task_boundary: Implement only CORP-02 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Counsel-approved private execution packet and corporate acceptance record.
Redacted chain-of-title receipt index containing document identifiers, digests, dates, parties by role, authority, scope, exclusions, custody, and verification result.
acceptance_criteria: Qualified counsel approves the instrument set before execution.
All required parties and corporate authorities execute or receive an explicit blocking disposition.
Private instruments remain outside the public repository and company-controlled custody is verified.
Redacted receipts bind each executed instrument to the asset schedule without exposing signatures, addresses, secrets, or privileged advice.
non_goals: Drafting legal advice in repository prose
Representing redacted receipts as the legal instruments
